title: No jumps allowed
description:
Write these **without any jump**, using `cmov`, `set`*cc*, and arithmetic (signed numbers):

| Function | Result |
|---|---|
| `min(a, b)` | the smaller |
| `max3(a, b, c)` | the largest of three |
| `abs_value(x)` | x without its sign (`abs` and `absolute` are reserved words in NASM) |
| `is_equal(a, b)` | 1 if a == b, else 0 |
| `is_negative(x)` | 1 if x < 0, else 0 |
| `count_true(a, b, c)` | how many of a, b, c are not zero |

starter.solution.asm:
min:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

max3:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

abs_value:
        mov     rax, rdi
        ret

is_equal:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

is_negative:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

count_true:
        xor     eax, eax
        ret

solution.solution.asm:
min:
        mov     rax, rdi
        cmp     rsi, rdi
        cmovl   rax, rsi
        ret

max3:
        mov     rax, rdi
        cmp     rsi, rax
        cmovg   rax, rsi
        cmp     rdx, rax
        cmovg   rax, rdx
        ret

abs_value:
        mov     rax, rdi
        neg     rax
        cmovs   rax, rdi
        ret

is_equal:
        xor     eax, eax
        cmp     rdi, rsi
        sete    al
        ret

is_negative:
        mov     rax, rdi
        shr     rax, 63                 ; the sign bit, moved to the bottom
        ret

count_true:
        xor     eax, eax
        xor     ecx, ecx
        test    rdi, rdi
        setne   cl
        add     eax, ecx
        test    rsi, rsi
        setne   cl
        add     eax, ecx
        test    rdx, rdx
        setne   cl
        add     eax, ecx
        ret

rules: No jumps: use cmov and setcc.
unitTests:
test "min"
    min(3, 9) == 3
    min(9, 3) == 3
    min(-5, 2) == -5
test "max3"
    max3(1, 2, 3) == 3
    max3(3, 2, 1) == 3
    max3(2, 3, 1) == 3
    max3(-1, -2, -3) == -1
test "abs_value"
    abs_value(-9) == 9
    abs_value(9) == 9
    abs_value(0) == 0
test "equal"
    is_equal(4, 4) == 1
    is_equal(4, 5) == 0
    is_equal(-1, -1) == 1
test "negative"
    is_negative(-1) == 1
    is_negative(0) == 0
    is_negative(55) == 0
    is_negative(0x8000000000000000) == 1
test "counting true values"
    count_true(0, 0, 0) == 0
    count_true(1, 0, 5) == 2
    count_true(-1, 2, 3) == 3
